title: Order Management
meta: A clear order workflow for your Shopify store: fulfilment steps, refund and exchange handling, and tagging. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Shopify order management, from paid to delivered
overview: We set up how orders move through your Shopify store and then work the first batch with you. That means tags and filters so nothing gets lost, a fulfilment routine with tracking, and written steps for refunds, exchanges and partial shipments. We process real open orders during the sprint, so you see the routine working. Monthly order handling is quoted separately.

faq: Do you handle refunds with my payment account?

We can prepare and process refunds from your Shopify admin if you give us the permission, following your own policy. We never touch your bank or payout settings, and we ask before any refund above a limit you set.
Yes, for order questions, using wording you approve. We start with short templates for delays, exchanges and refunds, and we sign messages as your store team unless you tell us otherwise.
No. We manage the order side inside Shopify: status, tracking numbers and customer updates. Your warehouse, supplier or 3PL still packs and ships, and we can connect their tracking to the order.
No. It is a fixed starter sprint with a set number of orders. If you want continuing support after it, we quote a monthly plan once we know your order volume and how many people reach out.
